question: Write tan⁻¹((cos x - sin x)/(cos x + sin x)) in simplest form for 0 < x < π.
explanation: Divide numerator and denominator by cos x: tan⁻¹((1-tan x)/(1+tan x)) = tan⁻¹(tan(π/4 - x)) = π/4 - x in the range.
